title: Gateway staging, SQL Server CDC: rows of a renamed table keep the old name

found.by: lfc-schema-change-test gateway-staging samples: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard CDC, utility 1.7, serverless gateway

symptom: after sp_rename rename_table -> rename_table_new, an insert into rename_table_new is staged as table rename_table, schemaVersion 0; no schema change event
cause: the CDC capture instance keeps its table's object id across a rename; the gateway reads it under the name it started with
effect: the new name never appears in staging; a reader keyed by table name keeps the rows under the old name without knowing of the rename
fix: track tables by table_id.uoid, not name; detect renames on the source (sys.tables) if the name matters
